groups.title: Section A · 第 1 篇 · 1–2 题
groups.material: A waiter has returned a check worth nearly $424,000 to the retired social worker who lost it. The waiter found a bank envelope while cleaning off a table last Saturday at a restaurant. He ran outside but the customer was gone. He opened the envelope and got a shock. After an unsuccessful search, the restaurant's owner called the Daily News for help. The "relieved" customer was reunited with her check on Wednesday. It contained money from her apartment sale, already planned for a down payment on a new home. The customer did not tip the waiter after her meal. She tried to give him money later on, but he graciously declined. The waiter, who's working his way through school, did accept the customer's apology and gratitude and said he was happy to have helped her.

groups.title: Section A · 第 2 篇 · 3–4 题
groups.material: The village of Maref in Alaska voted on Tuesday to move to the state's mainland. The move is due to global warming and rising sea levels. Most of the village's 169 registered voters took part in the town hall meeting. They decided in a vote of 89 to 78 to move from their land on Sarichef Island, near the Arctic Circle. Maref Council Secretary Donna Barr said the vote was largely symbolic. It will be costly financially to the community. "About 15 years ago, they estimated the cost at $180 million. I would figure it's much higher now," Barr said. "We don't see the move happening in our lifetime because of the funding." The village's roughly 650 residents have seen warming temperatures melt sea ice and permanently frozen land. This has resulted in houses falling into the water. At least 31 villages in Alaska face "immediate threats" due to climate change, the Government Accountability Office reported in 2009.

groups.title: Section A · 第 3 篇 · 5–7 题
groups.material: A man in Halifax, Canada, wanted to find out if people were thankful for someone holding the door open for them. The social experiment showed that 99 out of 100 people expressed gratitude. "I didn't think we were going to get 99. I don't know why, but I was pleasantly surprised because it went beyond just 'thank you.' People got into conversations with us," said Steve Foran, CEO of Gratitude at Work. "What we know from research is that from grateful people come good things," he said. "A simple way to induce gratitude in people is opening doors and so we went to six places and opened the doors for people." For the experiment, Foran's team went to a shopping center, a mall, two office buildings, and a coffee shop. The door was held for 15 to 20 people at a time at each location. "We did have one that didn't say thank you. We're not here to judge them because on any given day, that could be me or you. I suspect out of the 100 people, there were probably a bunch of them having a bad day, but grateful people make people grateful," said Foran.

groups.title: Section B · 第 1 篇 · 8–11 题
groups.material:
W: Rays Solar. Lisa's speaking. How can I help?
M: Hi, my name is Winston. I wish to enquire about solar panel installations.
W: Yes. What would you like to know?
M: Well. My neighbor installed panels on his roof about a year ago in order to power his hot water. He tells me it has saved him over $500 thus far. Does that sound about right to you?
W: Well. I'm not familiar with your neighbor or his particular setup, but that amount is definitely possible. I can tell you that the average four-bedroom house may typically have a roof with 50 square meters of surface area. Four panels on one side of that roof could save a family of four around $300 a year.
M: OK. That sounds about right then. My house is about the size you described, but my neighbor's is bigger. I'm not sure how many panels he has up there, but he does have a large family of six.
W: Are you interested in installing some solar panels on your roof, sir?
M: Yes, I'm considering it.
W: If you wish to come into our office, we could show you the different solutions we offer.
M: OK. I might do that. But just quickly, if you don't mind, could you tell me approximately how much a typical installation costs, like, say, four panels?
W: Prices do vary depending on different factors, but as a rough estimate, it's around $2,000. But you know a typical household will make back that initial investment in about five years.
M: OK. I see. Thank you.

groups.title: Section B · 第 2 篇 · 12–15 题
groups.material:
M: Good afternoon. Sorry to have kept you waiting. How can I help you?
W: Oh, no problem. I'm interested in booking a holiday to Australia and wonder if you could tell me what deals you have.
M: Sure. Are you only looking for flights or a package holiday with everything included?
W: When you say "everything," what do you mean?
M: Well, a package holiday would include your flights, hotels, meals, day trips to different places of interest and transport to and from the airport.
W: Yeah, that sounds pretty good. I'm going with my family, so it would be nice to have everything taken care of. So, what sort of deals do you have for package holidays then?
M: All sorts, really. How long do you want to go for and what dates?
W: Two weeks around Christmas time would be great.
M: Okay, let me check that for you. Here's one, 14 nights in southeastern Australia. Five nights in Sydney and five nights in Melbourne, and then for the other four nights you can choose from a list of trips to other places nearby. You could visit Canberra, for example, or the Blue Mountains, or you could go for a drive down the Great Ocean Road. Also, if you're interested in wine, you could go on a tour of the places where they grow grapes and make wine.
W: That sounds great. It's good we can choose some activities ourselves.

groups.title: Section C · 第 1 篇 · 16–18 题
groups.material: Tourists taking a holiday in the Indonesian island of Bali are facing a new $14-per-person tax when they arrive on the holiday island from next year. But this is a green tax, which Bali Governor Wayan Koster has been working on for months, and which is designed to help clean up the island's natural environment, and with good reason, too. Indonesia is drowning in plastics. Recycling is not one of the country's strong points. It's not uncommon to be offered many more plastic bags than one could ever need when visiting supermarkets and shopping malls. But, slowly, things are starting to change for the better. Back in 2016, the medium-sized city of Banjarmasin banned single-use plastic bags. The city of Bogor followed suit in 2018. A few months ago, Koster announced a plan that would not only ban single-use plastic bags from supermarkets and convenience stores, but plastic bags and straws across the island. The regulation will come into full effect next month. "We received a fast and quick response from the Balinese people. Not only positive responses from the Balinese, we received good responses from the central government, other local governments and even from overseas." Koster told the Sydney Morning Herald this week during an interview. The governor is a determined environmentalist and he has more laws planned to protect the island's waterways, in particular, and to support the introduction of electric vehicles too.

groups.title: Section C · 第 2 篇 · 19–21 题
groups.material: An endangered species of whale is experiencing a small-baby boom off the coast of America. The North Atlantic right whale is one of the rarest species of whale on the planet, numbering only about 411. But the Center for Coastal Studies said Friday that its aerial survey team spotted a mum with two babies in Cape Cod Bay a day earlier. That brings the number seen in nearby waters alone this year to three. That's big news because the whale population has been falling, and no baby whales were seen last year. In all, seven baby whales have been spotted so far this year. The whale population has become endangered due to commercial whaling activities in recent years. This is because they are sometimes hunted for their meat or their skin. Over-hunting could lead to the disappearance of the whale population, possibly causing major problems to the global food chain. The whales give birth off the Southeast Coast of America in the winter and travel to feeding grounds off the Northeast Coast in the early spring. The Northeast Coast is a critically important source of food. The animals often feed close to shore. This provides watchers on land with "unbeatable views of one of the rarest of marine mammals." It's illegal to get within 1,500 feet of the animals without a federal research permit, so whale watchers are discouraged from attempting to get close to the whales.

groups.title: Section C · 第 3 篇 · 22–25 题
groups.material: An average person consumes 144 pints of milk a year, but 40% of that is poured onto cereal. And 60% of those people are children. But what was once advertised as nutritious is becoming unpopular. Americans drink 37% less milk than they did in the 1970s. And in the UK, dairy consumption overall has fallen by a third in the past 20 years. Milk is increasingly being described in a negative light. A recent blog suggested maybe people are drinking less milk because it is poisonous to many of us. Lactose is the sugar found in milk and dairy products. It needs a series of complex proteins to break it down. Without enough of these proteins, the lactose is broken down by bacteria in the human body. This can cause physical pain and produce gas in the stomach. However, after we have finished breast or formula feeding, most of us don't continue producing the complex proteins in our body, which are necessary to break down the lactose. Despite the problems in digesting milk, it does provide many benefits. Milk is nutritious. It contains vitamins A and D, as well as protein and isn't full of calories. You can test yourself by drinking a large glass of milk. If you get sick in your stomach within the next 24 hours, you are lacking in the proteins to digest milk.

questions.prompt: What does the news report say about the waiter?
options: He wanted to buy a home.
He suffered from a shock.
He lost a huge sum of money.
He did an unusual good deed.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the news report say about the waiter? 

 【翻译】 新闻报道中关于这位服务员说了什么? 
 A)  他想买房。 
 B)  他遭受了震惊。 
 C)  他损失了一大笔钱。 
 D)  他做了一件不同寻常的好事。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） He did an unusual good deed. 
 【定位】 P1 A waiter has returned a check worth nearly $424,000 to the retired social worker who lost it. ... He opened the envelope and got a shock. ... She tried to give him money later on, but he graciously declined. 
 一名服务员把一张面值近 424,000 美元、由一位退休社工弄丢的支票归还了。……他打开信封，吃了一惊。……她后来想给他钱，但他礼貌地谢绝了。 

 【信号】 开篇首句即点核心事件 。新闻短消息的答案信号是"开篇第一句的核心事件"：A waiter has returned a check worth nearly $424,000 to the retired social worker who lost it 一上来就交代了服务员做的事——归还巨额支票；再加上结尾 he graciously declined（婉拒酬谢），整段都在讲"服务员归还失物、不图回报"这件不寻常的好事。 

 【替换】 A waiter has returned a check worth nearly $424,000 ↔ did an unusual good deed 具体行为概括为"做好事" 
 he graciously declined ↔ unusual 婉拒酬谢印证"不寻常" 

 【排除】 A) 张冠李戴 录音确实念到"买房"相关内容——钱是 already planned for a down payment on a new home（已计划用作新房首付），但想买房的是丢钱的女顾客，不是服务员。本题问的是 the waiter，A 把顾客的打算安到服务员头上。  借用原文：already planned for a down payment on a new home 

 B) 原词陷阱 录音里 shock 这个词真的出现了——He opened the envelope and got a shock（他打开信封吃了一惊），所以"听到 shock 就选 B"很诱人。但"吃一惊"只是他打开信封那一刻的瞬时反应，不是新闻要讲的他做的事，更不是 suffered from a shock（遭受打击/惊吓）这种持续受害的意思，答非所问。  借用原文：He opened the envelope and got a shock 

 C) 张冠李戴 录音开篇就说支票是 the retired social worker who lost it（弄丢支票的退休社工）丢的，丢一大笔钱的是顾客，服务员恰恰是"捡到并归还"的人。C 把"丢钱"这一与服务员相反的角色硬安到服务员身上，与原文相反。  借用原文：the retired social worker who lost it
questions.spoken_text: What does the news report say about the waiter?

questions.prompt: What did the customer try to do when she got her check back?
options: Invite the waiter to a fancy dinner.
Tell her story to the Daily News.
Give some money to the waiter.
Pay the waiter's school tuition.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What did the customer try to do when she got her check back? 

 【翻译】 当这位顾客拿回她的账单时,她试图做什么? 
 A)  邀请这位服务员去高档餐厅用餐。 
 B)  把她的故事告诉《每日新闻》。 
 C)  给这位服务员一些钱。 
 D)  支付这位服务员的学费。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） Give some money to the waiter. 
 【定位】 P1 She tried to give him money later on, but he graciously declined. 
 她后来想给他钱，但他礼貌地谢绝了。 

 【信号】 题干 try 与原文 tried 直接对应 。答案信号是题干关键词 try 在录音里的对应落点：She tried to give him money later on 中的 tried to give 与题干 try to do 严丝合缝，这一句就是承载"她试图做什么"的答案句；后半 but he graciously declined 说明只是"试图"、并未成功，正扣题干的 try。 

 【替换】 She tried to give him money later on ↔ Give some money to the waiter give money 几乎原义对应 

 【排除】 A) 未提及 录音通篇只说她"试图给他钱"，从未提到 invite to a fancy dinner（请吃豪华大餐）这件事。A 是凭"答谢恩人请吃饭"的常识想当然，录音里查无此事。 
 B) 张冠李戴 录音里 Daily News 确实出现——the restaurant's owner called the Daily News for help（店主打电话向《每日新闻》求助），但联系报社的是餐厅店主，目的是找失主，不是顾客去"讲述她的故事"。B 盗用 Daily News 这个真出现的专名，把店主的行为安到顾客头上。  借用原文：the restaurant's owner called the Daily News for help 

 D) 原词陷阱 录音结尾提到服务员 who's working his way through school（半工半读、靠打工供自己上学），"school"这个词真出现了，于是"替他付学费"很有迷惑性。但录音只说他自己边打工边读书，从没说顾客要替他付 school tuition（学费）；顾客试图做的只是泛泛"给钱"，并非专门付学费。  借用原文：who's working his way through school

questions.prompt: What is Maref's vote on Tuesday about?
options: Whether or not to move to the state's mainland.
How to keep the village from sinking into the sea.
Where to get the funds for rebuilding their village.
What to do about the rising level of the seawater.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What is Maref's vote on Tuesday about? 

 【翻译】 Maref在周二的投票是关于什么的? 
 A)  是否搬迁到该州的大陆。 
 B)  如何防止村庄沉入海中。 
 C)  从哪里获得重建村庄的资金。 
 D)  如何应对海平面上升的问题。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） Whether or not to move to the state's mainland. 
 【定位】 P1 The village of Maref in Alaska voted on Tuesday to move to the state's mainland. 
 阿拉斯加的马雷夫村在周二投票决定搬迁到该州的大陆地区。 

 【信号】 开篇首句直陈事件 。新闻报道的导语句往往把"谁、何时、做了什么"一次说清，本段开篇 voted on Tuesday to move to the state's mainland 就把投票时间与投票内容直接抛出，这种"开篇即点题"是新闻题最强的定位信号，不必等转折。 

 【替换】 voted on Tuesday to move to the state's mainland ↔ Whether or not to move to the state's mainland. 做了的事改写成投票议题 

 【排除】 B) 原词陷阱 录音背景里确有"海平面上升、房屋落水"之意（houses falling into the water），B 用 sinking into the sea 蹭这个画面，但投票要做的是"搬走"，不是"想办法不让村子沉"——把背景威胁错当成投票内容。  借用原文：houses falling into the water 

 C) 原词陷阱 录音后段确实谈到钱（because of the funding），C 用 get the funds 蹭这个词，但"资金"是录音里解释"为何搬不动"的内容，不是这次投票要决定的事，属把后文的钱搬到投票议题上。  借用原文：because of the funding 

 D) 原词陷阱 录音确说搬迁起因是 global warming and rising sea levels，D 用 rising level of the seawater 蹭这个原因，但那是"为什么要搬"的背景，不是"投票决定做什么"；把起因当成了投票内容。  借用原文：global warming and rising sea levels
questions.spoken_text: What is Merriff's vote on Tuesday about?

questions.prompt: Why did Donna Barr say they wouldn't see the plan carried out any time soon?
options: It takes too long a time.
It costs too much money.
It has to wait for the state's final approval.
It faces strong opposition from many villagers.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why did Donna Barr say they wouldn't see the plan carried out any time soon? 

 【翻译】 为什么Donna Barr说他们不会很快看到该计划得以实施? 
 A)  需要太长时间。 
 B)  花费太多资金。 
 C)  必须等待州政府的最终批准。 
 D)  面临许多村民的强烈反对。 

 【答案】 B （细节题） It costs too much money. 
 【定位】 P1 It will be costly financially to the community. "We don't see the move happening in our lifetime because of the funding," Barr said. 
 这对社区来说在财务上代价高昂。巴尔说："由于资金问题，我们认为有生之年都看不到这次搬迁发生。" 

 【信号】 because of 直陈原因 。答案就藏在因果连词后面：because of the funding 用 because of 把"看不到搬迁发生"的原因直接点成"资金"，再加上前句 It will be costly financially，原因句的因果信号非常明确，听到 because of 后那个词就是答案。 

 【替换】 It will be costly financially to the community ↔ It costs too much money. costly financially 改写成 costs too much money 
 because of the funding ↔ It costs too much money. funding 印证钱是障碍 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 录音说"有生之年看不到"（in our lifetime）听着像"耗时长"，A 用 takes too long a time 蹭这个时间感，但 in our lifetime 是搬不成的"结果"而非"原因"，真正原因是钱（funding），不是时间。  借用原文：We don't see the move happening in our lifetime 

 C) 未提及 录音从头到尾没提"州政府最终审批"，C 的 wait for the state's final approval 是靠"政府工程要审批"的常识脑补的；虽然录音里有 state（the state's mainland），但那指"州的大陆"，与"审批"无关。 
 D) 原词陷阱 投票是 89 to 78，反对票确实不少，D 用 strong opposition from many villagers 蹭这个接近的票数，但录音明说搬不成是 because of the funding（资金），从未说是村民反对挡了路，把票数差错当成搬迁受阻的原因。  借用原文：in a vote of 89 to 78
questions.spoken_text: Why did Donna Barr say they wouldn't see the plan carried out any time soon?

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the social experiment?
options: To investigate whether people are grateful for help.
To see whether people hold doors open for strangers.
To explore ways of inducing gratitude in people.
To find out how people express gratitude.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What is the purpose of the social experiment? 

 【翻译】 这项社会实验的目的是什么? 
 A)  调查人们是否对帮助心存感激。 
 B)  看人们是否会为陌生人扶门。 
 C)  探索激发人们感恩之心的方法。 
 D)  弄清人们如何表达感激之情。 

 【答案】 A （目的题） To investigate whether people are grateful for help. 
 【定位】 P1 A man in Halifax, Canada, wanted to find out if people were thankful for someone holding the door open for them. 
 加拿大哈利法克斯的一名男子,想弄清楚人们会不会因为有人为自己开门而心怀感激。 

 【信号】 意图句 wanted to find out 。录音开头 wanted to find out if people were thankful 用 wanted to find out(想弄清楚)直白交代做实验的意图,这种"想……/为了弄清……"的意图句就是目的题的答案落点。 

 【替换】 wanted to find out if people were thankful for someone holding the door open ↔ To investigate whether people are grateful for help 近义词整句替换 

 【排除】 B) 原词陷阱 B 盗用了录音反复出现的 opening doors 与 hold the door open 字眼,但开门只是实验"手段",不是"目的";题问 purpose,把手段当目的就答非所问了。  借用原文：A simple way to induce gratitude in people is opening doors 

 C) 偷换概念 C 来自 A simple way to induce gratitude in people is opening doors,录音确实说了"诱发感激的方法",但那是说话人解释"为什么用开门",是手段的理由,不是这场实验本身要"查明"的目的;实验目的是看人们会不会感激,而非"探索诱发感激的方式"。  借用原文：A simple way to induce gratitude in people is opening doors and so we went to six places 

 D) 偷换概念 D 说目的是"查明人们如何表达感激"(how people express),但录音问的是人们"会不会"感激(if people were thankful),是"是否"而非"如何";把"是否感激"偷换成"如何表达",方向变了。  借用原文：wanted to find out if people were thankful
questions.spoken_text: What is the purpose of the social experiment?

questions.prompt: What did Steve Foran and his team do in the experiment?
options: They induced strangers to talk with them.
They helped 15 to 20 people in a bad mood.
They held doors open for people at various places.
They interviewed people who didn't say thank you.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What did Steve Foran and his team do in the experiment? 

 【翻译】 Steve Foran和他的团队在实验中做了什么? 
 A)  他们引导陌生人与他们交谈。 
 B)  他们帮助了15到20个心情不好的人。 
 C)  他们在不同地点为人们扶门。 
 D)  他们采访了没有说谢谢的人。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） They held doors open for people at various places. 
 【定位】 P1 For the experiment, Foran's team went to a shopping center, a mall, two office buildings, and a coffee shop. The door was held for 15 to 20 people at a time at each location. 
 为了这场实验,福兰的团队去了一家购物中心、一家商场、两栋办公楼和一家咖啡店。在每个地点,每次为 15 到 20 个人开门。 

 【信号】 行动叙述句 went to…held 。Foran's team went to a shopping center, a mall, two office buildings, and a coffee shop 加上 The door was held for 15 to 20 people,直接叙述团队的实际行动(去多处、开门),细节题答案就落在这种动作叙述句上。 

 【替换】 The door was held for 15 to 20 people ↔ They held doors open for people 被动转主动 
 went to a shopping center, a mall, two office buildings, and a coffee shop ↔ at various places 列举概括成上位词 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 A 说"诱使陌生人和他们交谈",看似呼应录音 People got into conversations with us,但录音是"人们(主动)和我们攀谈起来",并非团队"induce(诱使)"他们说话;把自然发生说成团队刻意为之,动作主体和性质都变了。  借用原文：People got into conversations with us 

 B) 原词陷阱 B 把录音原数 15 to 20 people 和后文 having a bad day 拼到一起,说团队"帮了 15 到 20 个心情不好的人"。但 15 到 20 是"每次开门服务的人数",bad day 是说话人事后的猜测,两者本不相干,被强行黏成一句,与原意不符。  借用原文：The door was held for 15 to 20 people at a time 

 D) 未提及 D 说团队"采访了没道谢的人",借用录音 We did have one that didn't say thank you 的字眼,但录音只是说"有一个人没道谢",且明说 We're not here to judge them,根本没提"采访(interview)"这个动作,属无中生有。  借用原文：We did have one that didn't say thank you

questions.prompt: What do we learn from the news report?
options: People can be educated to be grateful.
Most people express gratitude for help.
Most people have bad days now and then.
People are ungrateful when in a bad mood.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What do we learn from the news report? 

 【翻译】 我们从这则新闻报道中了解到什么? 
 A)  人们可以被教育得懂感恩。 
 B)  大多数人会对帮助表达感激。 
 C)  大多数人时不时会有糟糕的日子。 
 D)  人们在心情不好时不懂感恩。 

 【答案】 B （主旨题） Most people express gratitude for help. 
 【定位】 P1 The social experiment showed that 99 out of 100 people expressed gratitude. 
 这场社会实验显示,100 个人里有 99 个表达了感激。 

 【信号】 核心数据 99 out of 100 。The social experiment showed that 99 out of 100 people expressed gratitude 用"实验显示"引出 99/100 这个核心结果数据,这种"实验/数据表明"的句子承载整篇结论,是结论题的落点。 

 【替换】 99 out of 100 people expressed gratitude ↔ Most people express gratitude for help 具体比例概括为 most 

 【排除】 A) 过度推断 A 说"人可以被教育得懂感恩",像是从 induce gratitude in people(诱发感激)推来,但录音只说开门能"诱发"感激,没说人能"被教育(educated)"成感恩的人;从"诱发"跳到"教育"是多走了一步的推断。  借用原文：A simple way to induce gratitude in people is opening doors 

 C) 原词陷阱 C 说"大多数人时不时心情不好",借用录音 having a bad day 的字眼,但录音只是说"那个没道谢的人也许那天心情不好",是对"个别人"的猜测,不是整篇结论;把个别推测说成"大多数人"的普遍现象,以偏概全。  借用原文：there were probably a bunch of them having a bad day 

 D) 与原文相反 D 说"人们心情不好时就不感激",但报道的结论恰恰相反——99/100 都感激了,说话人还强调 grateful people make people grateful;把"绝大多数会感激"反成"心情差就不感激",方向完全拧了。  借用原文：grateful people make people grateful

questions.prompt: What is the man's purpose for calling the woman?
options: To order a solar panel installation.
To report a serious leak in his roof.
To enquire about solar panel installations.
To complain about the faulty solar panels.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What is the man's purpose for calling the woman? 

 【翻译】 男士打电话给女士的目的是什么? 
 A)  订购太阳能电池板安装服务。 
 B)  报告他屋顶有严重漏水。 
 C)  咨询太阳能电池板安装事宜。 
 D)  投诉有问题的太阳能电池板。 

 【答案】 C （目的题） To enquire about solar panel installations. 
 【定位】 P2 Hi, my name is Winston. I wish to enquire about solar panel installations. 
 你好，我叫 Winston。我想咨询一下太阳能板的安装。 

 【信号】 主动方自报来意句 。对话一接通，主动打电话的人 Winston 用 I wish to enquire about solar panel installations 一句话交代来意——这种"自报家门 + 说明来意"的句子就是目的题的答案信号，不必再往后听。 

 【替换】 I wish to enquire about solar panel installations ↔ To enquire about solar panel installations. 陈述句改不定式、近乎原句 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 选项借了录音反复出现的 installation 一词造"To order…installation"，但 Winston 全程只说 I'm considering it"在考虑"，从没下单。听到 installation 就选 order 正中圈套。  借用原文：Yes, I'm considering it. 

 B) 未提及 整段对话只谈咨询、省钱、价格，从未出现"漏水"或"报修"，report a serious leak 是凭空捏造，属预读时就该排除的反方向干扰。 
 D) 原词陷阱 选项借 solar panels 一词造"complain about the faulty solar panels"，可 Winston 是潜在新客户、从无抱怨，faulty（有故障的）更是录音没有的。听到 solar panels 就选投诉是被原词牵着走。  借用原文：Yes, I'm considering it.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about the man's neighbor from the conversation?
options: He plans to install solar panels.
He owns a four-bedroom house.
He saves $300 a year.
He has a large family.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What do we learn about the man's neighbor from the conversation? 

 【翻译】 从对话中我们了解到关于男士邻居的什么信息? 
 A)  他计划安装太阳能电池板。 
 B)  他拥有一栋四居室房屋。 
 C)  他每年节省300美元。 
 D)  他有一个大家庭。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） He has a large family. 
 【定位】 P6 My house is about the size you described, but my neighbor's is bigger. I'm not sure how many panels he has up there, but he does have a large family of six. 
 我家差不多就是你说的那个大小，但我邻居家更大。我不确定他屋顶上装了几块板，不过他家确实是个六口之家的大家庭。 

 【信号】 对比句后落在邻居身上 。Winston 先把自家与邻居对比 my neighbor's is bigger，再用强调句 he does have a large family of six 点出邻居的确切信息——does 加重语气正是答案落点，明确这条事实属于"邻居"。 

 【替换】 he does have a large family of six ↔ He has a large family. 具体"六口"概括成"大家庭" 

 【排除】 A) 张冠李戴 录音里"打算装板"的人是 Winston 本人 I'm considering it；邻居是"一年前已经装了"。把 Winston 的打算安到邻居头上，正是题干设的"问谁"陷阱。  借用原文：Yes, I'm considering it. 

 B) 原词陷阱 four-bedroom 出自店员举例的 the average four-bedroom house，是泛指的平均房型，且 Winston 说邻居家"更大"，邻居并非四居室。盗用 four-bedroom 原词张冠李戴。  借用原文：the average four-bedroom house 

 C) 原词陷阱 $300 出自店员的概算 save a family of four around \$300 a year，针对的是"四口之家"的假设；邻居省的是 over \$500。把 $300 套到邻居头上是数字张冠李戴。  借用原文：save a family of four around \$300 a year

questions.prompt: What is one of the man's chief concerns?
options: The service of the solar panel company.
The cost of a solar panel installation.
The maintenance of the solar panels.
The quality of the solar panels.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What is one of the man's chief concerns? 

 【翻译】 男士主要关心的问题之一是什么? 
 A)  太阳能电池板公司的服务。 
 B)  太阳能电池板安装的费用。 
 C)  太阳能电池板的维护。 
 D)  太阳能电池板的质量。 

 【答案】 B （细节题） The cost of a solar panel installation. 
 【定位】 P10 But just quickly, if you don't mind, could you tell me approximately how much a typical installation costs, like, say, four panels? 
 不过，不介意的话，能不能快速告诉我，一套典型的安装大概要多少钱，比如说，四块板？ 

 【信号】 主动发问句问价格 。Winston 用 could you tell me approximately how much a typical installation costs 主动开口追问"多少钱"——这种"他专门发问"的句子就是 chief concern 的落点，how much 直指费用。 

 【替换】 how much a typical installation costs ↔ The cost of a solar panel installation. how much costs 名词化为 the cost 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 店员说 we could show you the different solutions we offer 沾到"服务"，但那是店员的提议，Winston 并未就服务专门发问，不构成他的 chief concern。听到"提供方案"就选服务是被次要信息带偏。  借用原文：we could show you the different solutions we offer 

 C) 未提及 对话从头到尾没出现 maintenance 或保养相关内容，是凭"装板会涉及维护"的常识脑补出来的干扰项，应排除。 
 D) 未提及 录音没有谈"质量"，Winston 关心的是省钱与价钱，没就 quality 发问。该项同属凭常识脑补，未在对话出现。

questions.prompt: How long will it take a typical household to make back the initial investment?
options: One year and a half.
Less than four years.
Roughly six years.
About five years.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 How long will it take a typical household to make back the initial investment? 

 【翻译】 典型家庭需要多长时间收回初始投资? 
 A)  一年半。 
 B)  不到四年。 
 C)  大约六年。 
 D)  大约五年。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） About five years. 
 【定位】 P11 But you know a typical household will make back that initial investment in about five years. 
 不过你知道，一个典型家庭大约在五年内就能收回这笔初始投资。 

 【信号】 题干同词语境后的年数 。店员说 a typical household will make back that initial investment in about five years——"收回初始投资"的语境后面紧跟的年数 in about five years 就是答案信号，与题干 make back the initial investment 完全同框。 

 【替换】 in about five years ↔ About five years. about five years 近原词复现 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 录音里 about a year ago 提到邻居一年前装板，选项把它扭成"一年半回本"，盗用"一年"这个数字却安错了语境，与回本无关。  借用原文：about a year ago 

 B) 未提及 录音从未出现 four years 或"不到四年"的回本时长，是凭空捏造、又故意与正确的五年咬得很近来诱选，应排除。 
 C) 未提及 录音只说回本约五年，并无"六年"，roughly six years 同属与正确答案接近的捏造数字，专钓没听准约数的考生。

questions.prompt: Where is the conversation taking place?
options: At a travel agency.
At an Australian airport.
At an airline transfer service.
At a local transportation authority.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Where is the conversation taking place? 

 【翻译】 对话发生在哪里? 
 A)  在旅行社。 
 B)  在澳大利亚的机场。 
 C)  在航空公司中转服务处。 
 D)  在当地交通管理局。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） At a travel agency. 
 【定位】 P2 W: Oh, no problem. I'm interested in booking a holiday to Australia and wonder if you could tell me what deals you have. 
 女：哦，没关系。我想订一趟去澳大利亚的度假行程，想问问你们都有什么优惠套餐。 

 【信号】 业务内容暴露场景 。答案句不报地名，而靠业务定场景：女士说 booking a holiday to Australia 又问 what deals you have，加上第 3 段男士问 Are you only looking for flights or a package holiday——"订度假行程/卖套餐"这套业务只可能发生在旅行社。 

 【替换】 booking a holiday to Australia ↔ At a travel agency 办的业务对应办事机构 

 【排除】 B) 原词陷阱 选项 At an Australian airport. 盗用了录音里的 Australia 一词，但澳大利亚只是"要去的目的地"，对话此刻发生在出发地的旅行社，并非身处澳洲机场——听到 Australia 就选机场即中招。  借用原文：a holiday to Australia 

 C) 原词陷阱 选项 At an airline transfer service. 靠录音里的 flights 制造联想，但对话谈的是订整套度假产品，不是单纯办转机；录音从没提转机服务，属由原词外推过头。  借用原文：only looking for flights 

 D) 未提及 选项 At a local transportation authority. 在录音中找不到任何对应，对话从头到尾是订旅游套餐，与地方交通管理部门毫无关系，属凭"transport"一词硬凑。

questions.prompt: Why is the woman interested in package holidays?
options: She would be able to visit more scenic spots.
She wanted to save as much money as possible.
She would like to have everything taken care of.
She wanted to spend more time with her family.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why is the woman interested in package holidays? 

 【翻译】 女士为什么对跟团游感兴趣? 
 A)  她能够游览更多景点。 
 B)  她想尽可能多地省钱。 
 C)  她希望一切都有人安排妥当。 
 D)  她想和家人度过更多时间。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） She would like to have everything taken care of. 
 【定位】 P6 W: Yeah, that sounds pretty good. I'm going with my family, so it would be nice to have everything taken care of. 
 女：是的，那听起来挺不错的。我是和家人一起去，所以要是一切都能被安排妥当就好了。 

 【信号】 因果 so 引出真实理由 。答案落在因果词 so 之后：女士先说和家人同行，紧接 so it would be nice to have everything taken care of——so 后面这句才是她偏好套餐的真正原因，正是被问者亲口给出的应答。 

 【替换】 it would be nice to have everything taken care of ↔ She would like to have everything taken care of 委婉愿望换成直陈愿望 

 【排除】 A) 张冠李戴 选项 She would be able to visit more scenic spots. 靠录音里男士提的 day trips to different places of interest 制造联想，但那是男士介绍套餐含什么、不是女士给的理由；女士的理由是"省心"，不是"多看景点"。  借用原文：day trips to different places of interest 

 B) 未提及 选项 She wanted to save as much money as possible. 听着是订套餐的常见动机，但录音里女士全程没提钱、没提省钱，这是凭常识脑补出来的理由，原文无据。 
 D) 原词陷阱 选项 She wanted to spend more time with her family. 盗用了女士说的 I'm going with my family，但"和家人一起去"只是事实背景、是"想省心"的前提，并非她偏好套餐的理由本身——听到 family 就选即中招。  借用原文：I'm going with my family

questions.prompt: How long does the woman want to go for the holiday?
options: Four days.
Five days.
One week.
Two weeks.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 How long does the woman want to go for the holiday? 

 【翻译】 女士想去度假多长时间? 
 A)  四天。 
 B)  五天。 
 C)  一周。 
 D)  两周。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） Two weeks. 
 【定位】 P8 W: Two weeks around Christmas time would be great. 
 女：圣诞节前后去两周就很好了。 

 【信号】 被问者对时长的直接应答 。第 7 段男士问 How long do you want to go for and what dates?，女士第 8 段直接答 Two weeks around Christmas time——这是被问者对"去多久"的正面回答，答案就落在回答方这句，不在后面男士报行程的数字里。 

 【替换】 Two weeks ↔ Two weeks 时长原词直接对应 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 选项 Four days. 盗用男士报行程时的 the other four nights，但那是 14 晚里"自选行程"的四晚，是其中一段、不是总时长；听到 four 就选即落入数字陷阱。  借用原文：the other four nights 

 B) 原词陷阱 选项 Five days. 盗用 Five nights in Sydney and five nights in Melbourne 里的 five，但那是悉尼、墨尔本各住五晚的分段天数，与女士想去的两周总时长无关。  借用原文：five nights in Sydney and five nights in Melbourne 

 C) 未提及 选项 One week. 录音并未念出"一周"，它靠 14 nights 让人误折算/误记；女士明确说的是两周，one week 既非原话也非她的意思。

questions.prompt: What does the woman say she likes about the holiday package?
options: Choosing some activities herself.
Spending Christmas with Australians.

questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the woman say she likes about the holiday package? 

 【翻译】 女士说她喜欢这个度假套餐的什么? 
 A)  自己选择一些活动。 
 B)  与澳大利亚人一起过圣诞节。 
 C)  沿着大洋路自驾。 
 D)  更多地了解葡萄酒酿造。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） Choosing some activities herself. 
 【定位】 P10 W: That sounds great. It's good we can choose some activities ourselves. 
 女：那听起来太棒了。我们能自己挑一些活动，这点很好。 

 【信号】 表态句 It's good… 点出喜好 。答案落在女士的点赞句：It's good we can choose some activities ourselves——It’s good 是明确的正面表态信号，她真正说喜欢的就是"能自己挑活动"这一点，而非前一段男士罗列的各项活动。 

 【替换】 we can choose some activities ourselves ↔ Choosing some activities herself we…ourselves 概括为 herself

 D) 原词陷阱 选项 Learning more about wine making. 盗用男士说的 make wine/葡萄酒之旅，同样是清单里的一项可选活动，女士没说喜欢酿酒，她点赞的是"能自己选"。  借用原文：if you're interested in wine, you could go on a tour

questions.prompt: What would tourists have to do when they visit Indonesia's Bali Island?
options: Bring their own bags when shopping.
Use public transport when traveling.
Dispose of their trash properly.
Pay a green tax upon arrival.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What would tourists have to do when they visit Indonesia's Bali Island? 

 【翻译】 游客在访问印度尼西亚的巴厘岛时必须做什么? 
 A)  购物时自带购物袋。 
 B)  旅行时使用公共交通。 
 C)  妥善处理自己的垃圾。 
 D)  抵达时缴纳绿色税。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） Pay a green tax upon arrival. 
 【定位】 P1 Tourists taking a holiday in the Indonesian island of Bali are facing a new $14-per-person tax when they arrive on the holiday island from next year. But this is a green tax. 
 到印尼巴厘岛度假的游客，从明年起抵达这座度假岛屿时将面临一项每人 14 美元的新税。不过这是一项绿色税（环保税）。 

 【信号】 录音开头点题句 。篇章独白往往开头第一句就把核心事实抛出来，本篇正是如此：Tourists taking a holiday in the Indonesian island of Bali are facing a new \$14-per-person tax when they arrive，紧接着 But this is a green tax 点明这税的性质。开篇就出现"游客 + 抵达 + 交税"，正对题干所问，是答案句。 

 【替换】 facing a new \$14-per-person tax when they arrive ↔ Pay a green tax upon arrival 面临交税=要交税 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 选项 Bring their own bags when shopping. 看似很环保、很合理，但原文从未要求游客购物自带袋；它只是利用 bags 这个全篇反复出现的词来诱你"听到 bags 就选"，属于答非所问。  借用原文：ban single-use plastic bags 

 B) 未提及 选项 Use public transport when traveling. 在原文里完全没有对应内容，原文末尾提到的是 electric vehicles（电动车），与坐公共交通不是一回事，属于未提及。 
 C) 答非所问 选项 Dispose of their trash properly. 同样听起来很"环保正确"，但原文谈的是政府层面的征税、禁塑、清理环境（clean up the island's natural environment），并没有要求游客自己妥善处理垃圾，属答非所问。  借用原文：clean up the island's natural environment

questions.prompt: What does the passage say about Indonesia?
options: It has not been doing a good job in recycling.
It has witnessed a rise in accidental drowning.
It has not attracted many tourists in recent years.
It has experienced an overall decline in air quality.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the passage say about Indonesia? 

 【翻译】 文章关于印度尼西亚说了什么? 
 A)  它在回收利用方面做得不好。 
 B)  它目睹了意外溺水事件的增加。 
 C)  近年来它没有吸引很多游客。 
 D)  它经历了空气质量的整体下降。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） It has not been doing a good job in recycling. 
 【定位】 P1 Indonesia is drowning in plastics. Recycling is not one of the country's strong points. 
 印尼正被塑料垃圾淹没。回收并不是这个国家的强项。 

 【信号】 对象名+负面定性句 。录音里一出现题干对象 Indonesia is drowning in plastics，紧接的 Recycling is not one of the country's strong points 就给出对印尼的明确评价——回收不是强项。带 not one of…strong points 的否定定性句，正是承载答案的信号句。 

 【替换】 Recycling is not one of the country's strong points ↔ not been doing a good job in recycling 回收非强项=回收做得不好 

 【排除】 B) 原词陷阱 选项 It has witnessed a rise in accidental drowning. 盗用了原文 Indonesia is drowning in plastics 里的 drowning。原文 drowning in plastics 是"被塑料淹没"的比喻，与真人溺水（accidental drowning）毫无关系，是典型听到原词就上当的陷阱。  借用原文：Indonesia is drowning in plastics 

 C) 原词陷阱 选项 It has not attracted many tourists in recent years. 虽然原文确有 tourists 一词（Tourists taking a holiday in the Indonesian island of Bali），但原文只说游客来度假、要交税，从未说近年游客变少，属未提及。  借用原文：Tourists taking a holiday in the Indonesian island of Bali 

 D) 未提及 选项 It has experienced an overall decline in air quality. 讲空气质量下降，但全篇只谈塑料、回收、水道（protect the island's waterways），从头到尾没提空气，属未提及。

questions.prompt: What is the new plan Governor Koster recently announced?
options: To charge a small fee on plastic products in supermarkets.
To ban single-use plastic bags and straws on Bali Island.
To promote the use of paper bags for shopping.
To impose a penalty on anyone caught littering.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What is the new plan Governor Koster recently announced? 

 【翻译】 Koster省长最近宣布的新计划是什么? 
 A)  对超市里的塑料产品收取小额费用。 
 B)  禁止在巴厘岛使用一次性塑料袋和吸管。 
 C)  推广使用纸袋购物。 
 D)  对任何被抓到乱扔垃圾的人处以罚款。 

 【答案】 B （细节题） To ban single-use plastic bags and straws on Bali Island. 
 【定位】 P1 A few months ago, Koster announced a plan that would not only ban single-use plastic bags from supermarkets and convenience stores, but plastic bags and straws across the island. 
 几个月前，Koster 宣布了一项计划，不仅要禁止超市和便利店里的一次性塑料袋，还要禁止全岛范围内的塑料袋和吸管。 

 【信号】 announced a plan标志句 。题干问 new plan…announced，录音里 Koster announced a plan 就是对应的标志句；其后 not only…but…结构 ban single-use plastic bags…but plastic bags and straws across the island 把计划内容铺开。听到 announced a plan 就该锁定这句。 

 【替换】 ban single-use plastic bags…but plastic bags and straws across the island ↔ ban single-use plastic bags and straws on Bali Island 全岛禁塑袋吸管=岛上禁 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 选项 To charge a small fee on plastic products in supermarkets. 借了原文 supermarkets 一词（ban single-use plastic bags from supermarkets and convenience stores），但新计划是 ban（禁用）不是 charge a fee（收费），把治理动词偷换了，是收费 vs 禁用的细微差别陷阱。  借用原文：ban single-use plastic bags from supermarkets and convenience stores 

 C) 未提及 选项 To promote the use of paper bags for shopping. 用了和 bags、shopping 同主题的词，但原文只字未提推广纸袋，新计划是禁塑而非倡导用纸袋，属未提及。 
 D) 答非所问 选项 To impose a penalty on anyone caught littering. 是另一种治理手段（罚乱扔垃圾），原文虽提到 Koster 还有别的护水道、推电动车的法规（he has more laws planned），但本题问的"最近宣布的这项新计划"是禁塑，不是罚乱扔，属答非所问。  借用原文：he has more laws planned

questions.prompt: What do we learn from the passage about the North Atlantic right whale?
options: It gives birth to several babies at a time.
It is the least protected mammal species.
It's breeding grounds are now better preserved.
It's population is now showing signs of increase.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What do we learn from the passage about the North Atlantic right whale? 

 【翻译】 从文章中我们对北大西洋露脊鲸了解到什么? 
 A)  它一次产下几头幼崽。 
 B)  它是受保护程度最低的哺乳动物物种。 
 C)  它的繁殖地现在得到了更好的保护。 
 D)  它的种群数量现在显示出增长的迹象。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） It's population is now showing signs of increase. 
 【定位】 P1 That brings the number seen in nearby waters alone this year to three. That's big news because the whale population has been falling, and no baby whales were seen last year. In all, seven baby whales have been spotted so far this year. 
 这使得仅在附近水域今年看到的（幼鲸）数量达到了三头。这是个大新闻，因为此前鲸鱼数量一直在下降、去年一头幼鲸都没见到。算下来，今年到目前已经发现了七头幼鲸。 

 【信号】 big news 加数字对比 。信号是强调性短语加前后数字对比：原文说 That's big news because the whale population has been falling, and no baby whales were seen last year，用 big news（大新闻）点出这是个值得注意的转好，再用"去年一头幼鲸都没有"对比"今年发现七头"，正面变化被强调出来——被加重语气和数字对比点亮的这句就是答案句。 

 【替换】 seven baby whales have been spotted so far this year ↔ population is now showing signs of increase 具体数字概括为数量回升 

 【排除】 A) 过度推断 原文提到一头母鲸带着 a mum with two babies（一只母鲸带两个幼崽），听到 two babies 容易让人以为"一次生好几个"，但"带着两个幼崽"不等于"一胎产数仔"，原文没说生育方式，属于把零散信息脑补成 A 项。  借用原文：a mum with two babies 

 B) 原词陷阱 原文确实多次提到保护/濒危（如下文讲"靠近它们是非法的"），It is the least protected mammal species. 借"保护"这个话题词来诱选，但原文从没说它是"最不受保护的"哺乳动物，least（最不）这个极端程度是选项自己加的，与原文不符。  借用原文：It's illegal to get within 1,500 feet of the animals without a federal research permit 

 C) 原词陷阱 原文提到鲸鱼在东南海岸 give birth off the Southeast Coast of America（繁殖产崽），It's breeding grounds are now better preserved. 借"繁殖地"这个话题词诱选，但原文只说它在哪里繁殖、迁去哪里觅食，从没说"繁殖地被更好地保护了"，better preserved 是无中生有。  借用原文：The whales give birth off the Southeast Coast of America in the winter

questions.prompt: What has caused the decline of the whale population in recent years?
options: Global warming.
Polluted seawaters.
Commercial hunting.
Decreasing birthrates.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What has caused the decline of the whale population in recent years? 

 【翻译】 是什么导致了近年来鲸鱼种群数量的下降? 
 A)  全球变暖。 
 B)  海水污染。 
 C)  商业捕猎。 
 D)  出生率下降。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） Commercial hunting. 
 【定位】 P1 The whale population has become endangered due to commercial whaling activities in recent years. This is because they are sometimes hunted for their meat or their skin. 
 近年来，由于商业捕鲸活动，鲸鱼种群已变得濒危。这是因为它们有时会因肉或皮而遭到猎杀。 

 【信号】 因果信号 due to 加 because 。信号是连续两个因果标志：原文 has become endangered due to commercial whaling activities 用 due to（由于）直接给出原因，紧接着 This is because they are sometimes hunted 又用 because 进一步解释——因果信号词扎堆出现的这句，就是原因题的答案句。 

 【替换】 due to commercial whaling activities ↔ Commercial hunting 捕鲸等于商业猎杀 

 【排除】 A) 未提及 Global warming. 全球变暖是动物濒危话题里最"想当然"的原因，但通篇原文只字未提变暖，它是利用考生常识设的坑——凭"濒危动物多半是因为气候"的惯性去选，正好中招。 
 B) 未提及 Polluted seawaters. 海水污染同样是海洋动物受害的"标准答案式"原因，听上去合理，但原文从头到尾没有提到污染，是又一个用常识诱选、原文无据的干扰。 
 D) 原词陷阱 原文提过 no baby whales were seen last year（去年没见到幼鲸），Decreasing birthrates. 出生率下降借这点诱选，但原文是把数量下降归因于商业捕鲸，从没说"出生率下降"是原因；"去年没见到幼鲸"是数量下降的表现，不是题目问的原因，属于因果错位。  借用原文：no baby whales were seen last year

questions.prompt: Why do the whales travel to the Northeast Coast of America in the early spring?
options: To mate.
To look for food.
To escape hunters.
To seek breeding grounds.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why do the whales travel to the Northeast Coast of America in the early spring? 

 【翻译】 为什么鲸鱼在早春时节前往美国东北海岸? 
 A)  交配。 
 B)  寻找食物。 
 C)  逃避捕猎者。 
 D)  寻找繁殖地。 

 【答案】 B （目的题） To look for food. 
 【定位】 P1 The whales give birth off the Southeast Coast of America in the winter and travel to feeding grounds off the Northeast Coast in the early spring. The Northeast Coast is a critically important source of food. 
 鲸鱼冬天在美国东南海岸产崽，早春则迁往东北海岸的觅食区。东北海岸是一处极其重要的食物来源。 

 【信号】 feeding grounds 加 source of food 。信号是"动作去某地 + 紧接的解释"：原文先说 travel to feeding grounds off the Northeast Coast（迁往东北海岸的觅食区），下一句又补 The Northeast Coast is a critically important source of food（东北海岸是极重要的食物来源），两处 feeding/food 反复点出目的就是觅食——这就是目的题的答案落点。 

 【替换】 travel to feeding grounds off the Northeast Coast ↔ To look for food 觅食区即为找食物 

 【排除】 A) 张冠李戴 原文确实提到鲸鱼 give birth off the Southeast Coast（在东南海岸产崽），To mate. 交配借这点诱选，但产崽/交配发生在东南海岸的冬天，而题目问的是早春迁往东北海岸的目的，地点和季节都对不上，属于张冠李戴。  借用原文：give birth off the Southeast Coast of America in the winter 

 C) 原词陷阱 原文多处提到 hunt/hunters（如 hunted for their meat、whale watchers），To escape hunters. 躲避猎人借这个反复出现的耳熟词诱选，但原文从没说鲸鱼迁往东北海岸是为了躲猎人，迁徙目的明明白白是觅食，hunters 只是别处话题，与本题目的无关。  借用原文：they are sometimes hunted for their meat or their skin 

 D) 偷换概念 原文提到鲸鱼在东南海岸产崽繁殖，To seek breeding grounds. 寻找繁殖地借"繁殖"这一话题词诱选，但繁殖是在东南海岸、冬天的事，迁往东北海岸是为了 feeding grounds（觅食区）而非 breeding grounds（繁殖地），选项把"觅食"偷换成了"繁殖"。  借用原文：travel to feeding grounds off the Northeast Coast

questions.prompt: What does the passage say about Americans?
options: They prefer to drink low-fat milk.
They think milk is good for health.
They consume less milk these days.
They buy more milk than the British.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the passage say about Americans? 

 【翻译】 这篇文章关于美国人说了什么? 
 A)  他们更喜欢喝低脂牛奶。 
 B)  他们认为牛奶有益健康。 
 C)  他们如今消耗的牛奶更少了。 
 D)  他们购买的牛奶比英国人多。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） They consume less milk these days. 
 【定位】 P1 Americans drink 37% less milk than they did in the 1970s. 
 美国人喝的牛奶比上世纪七十年代少了百分之三十七。 

 【信号】 对象名+数字下降，直接应答句 。这句以 Americans 开头直接讲美国人，又带具体数字 37% less milk，是对 What about Americans 的直接事实陈述，数字 + 比较（than they did in the 1970s）就是答案信号。 

 【替换】 Americans drink 37% less milk than they did in the 1970s ↔ They consume less milk these days drink less=consume less，把具体数字概括为更少 

 【排除】 A) 未提及 prefer to drink low-fat milk 里的 low-fat（低脂）在录音中根本没出现，是凭对牛奶的常识臆造的好听说法。 
 B) 与原文相反 think milk is good for health 看似呼应原文 what was once advertised as nutritious，但原文紧接着说 is becoming unpopular，即如今观念已转向负面，选项却说成正面看法，正话反说。  借用原文：but what was once advertised as nutritious is becoming unpopular 

 D) 张冠李戴 buy more milk than the British 盗用原文出现过的 in the UK（英国），但原文只是分别说美国和英国的消费都在下降，从未把两国相比、更没说美国买得更多，属张冠李戴式的虚构比较。  借用原文：and in the UK, dairy consumption overall has fallen by a third in the past 20 years

questions.prompt: How do Americans and British people think of milk nowadays?
options: It is not as healthy as once thought.
It is not easy to stay fresh for long.
It benefits the elderly more.
It tends to make people fat.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 How do Americans and British people think of milk nowadays? 

 【翻译】 美国人和英国人现在如何看待牛奶? 
 A)  它不像曾经认为的那样健康。 
 B)  它不容易长时间保持新鲜。 
 C)  它对老年人更有益。 
 D)  它往往使人发胖。 

 【答案】 A （态度观点题） It is not as healthy as once thought. 
 【定位】 P1 But what was once advertised as nutritious is becoming unpopular. ... Milk is increasingly being described in a negative light. 
 但曾经被宣传为有营养的牛奶，如今正变得不受欢迎。……牛奶正越来越多地被以负面的方式描述。 

 【信号】 转折 But 与 negative 定调 。But what was once advertised as nutritious is becoming unpopular 由转折词 But 引出当下态度，再由 increasingly being described in a negative light 用 negative 把如今的看法定调为负面——转折后 + 负面评价词就是态度题的答案信号。 

 【替换】 what was once advertised as nutritious is becoming unpopular ↔ It is not as healthy as once thought 曾被当营养、如今转负=不如以前以为的健康 

 【排除】 B) 未提及 not easy to stay fresh for long 谈牛奶保鲜，录音通篇讲营养、消化与态度，从未提保鲜，属凭生活常识硬塞的内容。 
 C) 未提及 benefits the elderly more 说更利老人，录音只在后半提到牛奶有营养、有益处，从没说对老人益处更大，属无中生有的程度拔高。 
 D) 与原文相反 tends to make people fat 迎合喝奶会胖的常识，但原文后半明确说 isn't full of calories（热量并不高），与发胖说法相反。  借用原文：isn't full of calories

questions.prompt: Why does drinking milk cause pain in some people?
options: They drink too many pints every day.
They are sensitive to certain minerals.
They lack the necessary proteins to digest it.
They have eaten food incompatible with milk.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why does drinking milk cause pain in some people? 

 【翻译】 为什么喝牛奶会导致某些人疼痛? 
 A)  他们每天喝太多品脱的牛奶。 
 B)  他们对某些矿物质敏感。 
 C)  他们缺乏消化牛奶所需的蛋白质。 
 D)  他们吃了与牛奶不相容的食物。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） They lack the necessary proteins to digest it. 
 【定位】 P1 It needs a series of complex proteins to break it down. Without enough of these proteins, the lactose is broken down by bacteria in the human body. This can cause physical pain and produce gas in the stomach. 
 乳糖需要一系列复杂的蛋白质来分解它。如果这些蛋白质不够，乳糖就会被人体内的细菌分解，这会引起身体疼痛并在胃里产生气体。 

 【信号】 Without enough proteins…cause pain 的因果链 。Without enough of these proteins 引出缺蛋白质这一条件，紧接 This can cause physical pain 给出疼痛后果——缺蛋白质→疼痛的因果链就是答案信号。 

 【替换】 Without enough of these proteins, the lactose is broken down by bacteria ↔ They lack the necessary proteins to digest it without enough proteins=lack the necessary proteins 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 drink too many pints every day 盗用原文开头的 144 pints of milk a year 里的 pints，但那只是讲平均消费量，原文从没说喝太多导致疼痛，属答非所问。  借用原文：An average person consumes 144 pints of milk a year 

 B) 偷换概念 sensitive to certain minerals 把原文真正的关键词 proteins（蛋白质）偷换成 minerals（矿物质），原文谈的是缺蛋白质，与对矿物质敏感无关。  借用原文：It needs a series of complex proteins to break it down 

 D) 未提及 eaten food incompatible with milk 说吃了与牛奶相克的食物，录音只讲缺蛋白质、细菌分解乳糖，从未提食物相克，属凭民间说法臆造。

questions.prompt: What does the passage say is a benefit of milk?
options: It is easier for sick people to digest.
It provides some necessary nutrients.
It is healthier than other animal products.
It supplies the body with enough calories.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the passage say is a benefit of milk? 

 【翻译】 这篇文章说牛奶有什么好处? 
 A)  病人更容易消化它。 
 B)  它提供一些必需的营养素。 
 C)  它比其他动物产品更健康。 
 D)  它为身体提供足够的卡路里。 

 【答案】 B （细节题） It provides some necessary nutrients. 
 【定位】 P1 Despite the problems in digesting milk, it does provide many benefits. Milk is nutritious. It contains vitamins A and D, as well as protein and isn't full of calories. 
 尽管牛奶存在消化方面的问题，它确实提供许多益处。牛奶很有营养，含有维生素 A 和 D 以及蛋白质，而且热量并不高。
